children: TOYOTA MOTOR ENGINEERING & MANUFACTURING IS RECALLING 68,356 U.S. VEHICLES - NHTSA

TOYOTA MOTOR ENGINEERING & MANUFACTURING IS RECALLING SOME U.S. VEHICLES AS AN INSTRUMENT PANEL DISPLAY THAT FAILS TO SHOW ENGINE OIL PRESSURE, ENGINE COOLANT TEMPERATURE, OR ELECTRICAL CHARGE INCREASES THE RISK OF A CRASH.- NHTSA
